mapper.sql: ra.id, ra.job_id, ra.candidate_id, ra.resume_id, ra.status, ra.match_score, ra.ai_score, ra.ai_analysis, ra.reject_feedback, ra.submitted_at, ra.viewed_at, ra.screened_at, ra.interviewing_at, ra.offerable_at, ra.offered_at, ra.rejected_at, ra.withdrawn_at, ra.created_at, ra.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM resume_application ra WHERE ra.candidate_id = #{candidateId} ORDER BY ra.submitted_at DESC

SELECT , jp.title AS job_title, jp.city_name, jp.company_id, hc.name AS company_name, hc.logo_url AS company_logo FROM resume_application ra LEFT JOIN job_post jp ON ra.job_id = jp.id LEFT JOIN hr_company hc ON jp.company_id = hc.id WHERE ra.candidate_id = #{candidateId} ORDER BY ra.submitted_at DESC

SELECT , jp.title AS job_title, jp.city_name, jp.company_id, hc.name AS company_name, hc.logo_url AS company_logo FROM resume_application ra LEFT JOIN job_post jp ON ra.job_id = jp.id LEFT JOIN hr_company hc ON jp.company_id = hc.id WHERE ra.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM resume_application ra WHERE ra.job_id = #{jobId} AND ra.candidate_id = #{candidateId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_post WHERE id = #{jobId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.update: UPDATE resume_application SET status = 'SUBMITTED', resume_id = #{resumeId}, match_score = #{matchScore}, submitted_at = NOW(), viewed_at = NULL, screened_at = NULL, interviewing_at = NULL, offerable_at = NULL, offered_at = NULL, rejected_at = NULL, withdrawn_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE resume_application
status = #{toStatus},
${target} = NOW(),
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(ra.submitted_at) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM resume_application ra WHERE ra.submitted_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(ra.submitted_at) ORDER BY dt ASC
SELECT DISTINCT job_id FROM resume_application WHERE candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND status != 'WITHDRAWN'
